name: update_kms_issuer
description:
Update a KMS issuer's name or claims schema.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId} --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

anyOf.description: A JSON Schema used to validate the resolved token claims when signing tokens for this issuer. Pass null to remove it.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
